requirement.value: You must have been responsible for a Villain's redemption or demise

system.description:
On acquisition, name the Villain you brought down or brought back. You gain an extra Bond slot and a Bond toward them, emotions discussed with the group — then, together with the group, you create and acquire that Villain's Legacy: something your character learned from what they did. One of their iconic moves, a piece of rare equipment, or a whole new Skill. The Legacy is designed at the table, so it is only as balanced as the table makes it; agree its shape before it is written down. Source is unplaytested by its own admission.

GM-gated: not available at character creation.
